setting.match: Match each novel to where its story takes place.
setting.odd: Three of these novels are set in {value}. Which one is not?
setting.reverse: Which of these novels is set in {value}?

rows.label: Wuthering Heights
rows.hook: tells of a stormy, obsessive romance between a foundling and his adopted sister on windswept moors

rows.label: Sense and Sensibility
rows.hook: follows two sisters, one ruled by reason and one by emotion, as they search for husbands

rows.label: Crime and Punishment
rows.hook: follows a poor student who murders a pawnbroker and is tormented by guilt

rows.label: The Great Gatsby
rows.hook: follows a mysterious millionaire who throws lavish parties to win back a lost love in the Jazz Age

rows.label: Moby-Dick
rows.hook: follows a vengeful sea captain obsessed with hunting a giant white whale

rows.label: Fahrenheit 451
rows.hook: imagines a future where firemen burn books to keep people from thinking

rows.label: Brave New World
rows.hook: imagines an engineered society kept happy by a pleasure drug called soma and strict caste conditioning

rows.label: The Stranger
rows.hook: follows a detached clerk who shoots a man on a sunny beach, a landmark of absurdist fiction

rows.label: The Catcher in the Rye
rows.hook: follows a restless teenager named Holden Caulfield wandering after being expelled from prep school

rows.label: Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
rows.hook: tells of a respectable doctor whose potion unleashes a violent alter ego

rows.label: Journey to the West
rows.description: one of China's Four Great Classical Novels
rows.hook: follows a mischievous monkey king who escorts a monk on a pilgrimage to fetch sacred scriptures

rows.label: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
rows.description: science fiction novel by Philip K. Dick
rows.hook: follows a bounty hunter hunting rogue artificial humans, and inspired the film Blade Runner

rows.label: The Scarlet Letter
rows.hook: follows a woman in Puritan society forced to wear a red mark of shame for adultery

rows.label: For Whom the Bell Tolls
rows.hook: follows an American dynamiter fighting alongside guerrillas in a civil war

rows.label: Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
rows.hook: follows a boy and an escaped slave drifting downriver on a raft

rows.label: Oliver Twist
rows.hook: follows an orphan who asks for more gruel and falls in with a gang of child pickpockets

rows.label: Life of Pi
rows.hook: tells of a boy stranded on a lifeboat with a Bengal tiger after a shipwreck

rows.label: The Kite Runner
rows.hook: follows a man haunted by a childhood betrayal of his closest friend, a servant's son

rows.label: The Fountainhead
rows.hook: follows an uncompromising architect who refuses to give in to mediocrity and champions individualism

rows.label: The Phantom of the Opera
rows.hook: tells of a disfigured musical genius who haunts a grand theatre and obsesses over a young singer

rows.label: Dream of the Red Chamber
rows.description: one of China's Four Great Classical Novels
rows.hook: chronicles the rise and fall of a wealthy clan and a doomed romance, a masterpiece of its country's literature

rows.label: Siddhartha
rows.hook: follows a young man who leaves home on a spiritual quest for enlightenment in the time of the Buddha

rows.label: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
rows.description: 1876 adventure novel and bildungsroman by Mark Twain
rows.hook: follows a mischievous boy who tricks friends into whitewashing a fence and witnesses a murder in a graveyard

rows.label: The Name of the Rose
rows.hook: is a medieval whodunit in a monastery where a monk detective probes deaths tied to a forbidden book

rows.label: Mrs Dalloway
rows.hook: follows a society hostess preparing for a party over the course of a single day

rows.label: A Study in Scarlet
rows.description: first Sherlock Holmes novel by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle
rows.hook: introduced the world to a famous consulting detective and his doctor companion

rows.label: A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man
rows.description: 1918 autobiographical artist's novel and bildungsroman by James Joyce
rows.hook: follows Stephen Dedalus as he breaks from family, church and country to become a writer

rows.label: Love in the Time of Cholera
rows.description: novel by Colombian Nobel Prize-winning author Gabriel García Márquez
rows.hook: tells of a man who waits over fifty years to win the woman he adored as a youth

rows.label: The Plague
rows.hook: tells of a town sealed off by quarantine as an epidemic spreads, and a doctor who fights it
